assertion.statement: For a bounded finite free complex over a DVR, equality of generic and residue cohomology dimensions in every degree implies free cohomology commuting with reduction; its actual class-functional determinant tensor specializes in the same retained basis.
assertion.objects: A bounded finite free DVR complex C, actual cycle, actual closed functional and retained determinant basis.
assertion.hypotheses: Generic and residue cohomology dimensions agree in every degree. For the stated tensor coordinate the only nonzero dimensions are (1,1) in degrees one and two.
assertion.quantifiers: Every such bounded complex and actual cycle-functional pair.
assertion.parameter_range: A discrete valuation ring A with uniformizer t, fraction field F and residue field k.
assertion.uniformity: An exact algebraic implication; no uniform quantitative bound is inferred.
assertion.constants: No new numeric constant; only unit determinants from contractible summands occur.
assertion.normalizations: Use det inverse C and retain its same contractible-summand identifications before and after reduction.
assertion.exceptional_cases: Dimension equality cannot be omitted. A positive-valuation two-term disk raises residue dimensions in two adjacent degrees and is excluded by the hypothesis.
assertion.limit_order: Smith-reduce the bounded complex; exclude all positive-valuation disks using all-degree dimension equalities; remove only unit disks; specialize the actual tensor.
